body:
Adds `research/queue-twin` (Digital twins theme; builds on the HIRO lab-workcell direction, no affiliation implied).

- Exact Pollaczek–Khinchine mean wait: a twin with exponential service is off by `(1+c²)/2` at every load. Matched to 1.5M-job Lindley simulations within one standard error.
- At an SLA of 2 service times the twin admits ρ=0.667; real admits 0.444 (c²=4) or 0.133 (c²=25); real waits 2.5×–13× the SLA. Tail exceedance 11.7× the claim at c²=4.
- Pareto index < 2: infinite real mean wait, simulated mean keeps growing.
- Negative result: plug-in c² repair from n logs violates the SLA in 70–89% of repeats (n=25–1600); a 90% bootstrap bound still 46% at n=1600.
- 8 tests, seeded experiments, whitepaper with references, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Stylised (Poisson arrivals, one server, simulated "real" instrument, no lab data).
